ability.name: Scan Feasibility / Nmap Existence Check
ability.description: Inspect environment pathways to verify if Nmap is natively installed or available on PATH.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $nmapPath = Get-Command nmap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($nmapPath) { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\nmap_check.txt

rationale: Checking the footprint of tools like Nmap informs the runner on whether we can perform low-overhead, native tool-based scans or if we must fall back immediately to lightweight PowerShell scripts.
